title: [3.0.0.1] Incorrect (future) timestamp in AAPS+ NightScout on Dex sensor change (BYODA)
symptom: After changing to AAPS 3.0.0.1, the timestamp for sensor change is incorrect: sensor change happened 2022-Mar-10 07:26 CET but displayed in AAPS and sent to NightScout as 2106-02-07T06:28:1500Z. AAPS does not allow deleting this wrong data, only flagging as invalid.
cause: The thread does not definitively establish a root cause. One user suggests that using the action button may cause the issue, but the reporter states they did not use it. The maintainer added validation, implying a bug in timestamp handling.
fix: The maintainer added validation via commit 58b49a05eaefd96a9273942b46217e0fe0fb71e1, but no specific user-facing fix is described.
